trigger.closed_finding: Family 006 produced complete valid development evidence for both opening-auction roles, but DRIVE and FADE lost actual and stressed money in both years, exhausted almost all capital, missed turnover after risk blocks and had roughly 99.1% drawdown. Its response, session, clock, opening-window, filter, symbol, risk and exit neighborhood is frozen.

1_entry_signal_market_structure.reason: Families 001, 002, 004 and 005 already consumed materially distinct H1, H4, M15 and M1 outright or adaptive target-price carriers. A feature, target, model, threshold, horizon, symbol subgroup or direction rescue remains adjacent to those closed families.

2_external_market_event.reason: AUDCHF is an unconsumed broker-native external instrument whose numerator is growth-sensitive and whose denominator is a funding safe haven. A completed intraday AUDCHF impulse can therefore provide an independently observed directional event before a US-index action. Repository-wide non-runtime research and evidence contain zero AUDCHF reference, while thirteen isolated historical runtime caches contain an AUDCHF symbol path. This availability observation used names, lengths, timestamps and hashes only; it did not read a bar, tick value, target return or candidate outcome.

3_order_time_session.reason: Family 006 froze London and New York opening-auction DRIVE/FADE responses after complete adverse evidence. Another opening window, session, duration, clock, body threshold or auction-role variation would be an adjacent rescue. The New York hours in the selected successor are only a predeclared liquid overlap boundary; the external AUDCHF event, not the clock, chooses whether and which direction to act.

4_position_management_exit.reason: No independent Challenge entry family has passed development, so an exit-only successor still lacks a positive frozen entry base. Family 007 must declare its complete exit and risk contract before any outcome and may not optimize them afterward.

5_portfolio_capital_risk.reason: Family 003 froze residual-basket, hedge, pair, allocation, sizing and exit rescues, and Families 004-006 supplied no positive base that capital allocation could transform independently.

7_diagnostic_causal_meta.reason: Families 001-006 contain no positive complete role population for a causal selector. Closed outcome tapes may not become successor features, and a diagnostic-only layer would not create an independent executable action supply.

provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.decision_times: every 30 minutes from 10:00 through 15:30 local inclusive
provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.event: the return of the immediately completed AUDCHF 30-minute interval
provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.reference: the same local decision slot over the prior 60 complete eligible sessions, excluding the current session
provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.magnitude_gate: nonzero current absolute return at or above the fixed causal 75th-percentile nearest-rank of the 60 prior absolute returns
provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.direction: positive AUDCHF return is the positive carry-risk impulse; negative return is the negative impulse
provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.entry: the first target M1 open after the external 30-minute interval is complete
provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.maximum_hold: 30 target M1 bars so one scheduled slot closes before the next slot
provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.expected_structural_density_not_outcome_: 12 slots x approximately 25% gate incidence x 2 target symbols = approximately 6 starts per complete session after warmup; exact causal capacity must be proved before development

provisional_successor.python_decision_role: validate external and target timestamp geometry, construct completed AUDCHF half-hour returns, maintain the causal same-slot sixty-session rank reference and emit immutable two-symbol FOLLOW or FADE decisions under exact sequence and freshness contracts
provisional_successor.ea_role: validate adapter freshness and symbol contracts, size and submit each US index independently, own protection, timed close, aggregate risk, persistence, restart recovery and bounded evidence; the EA may not construct, suppress or invert an external direction
